# Relation catalog

<!-- Generated by RelationCatalogTest from vocab/Relation.kt. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every relationship type the projection writes, and what it may point at. The builder refuses
any other target, so this table is what a query can rely on. What each relation MEANS, and
which kinds state it, is in [vocabulary.md](vocabulary.md).

Targets: `event` (an `:Event`), `address` (an `:Address`), `user` (a `:User`), or a value type,
which is a `:Tag` node keyed `<type>:<value>`.

## Value types

| Type | What it is |
|---|---|
| `hashtag` | A topic: a `t` tag or a NIP-73 `#` id, lowercased. |
| `url` | A web resource: an `r` tag, a NIP-73 `http(s)` id, a URL input. |
| `geohash` | A place: a `g` geohash or a NIP-73 `geo:` id. |
| `external` | Any other NIP-73 external content id (`isbn:…`, `podcast:guid:…`, `doi:…`), as written. |
| `kind` | An event kind: a number, or a NIP-73 kind (`web`, `isbn`) where a NIP-22 `K`/`k` names one. |
| `language` | An ISO 639 language code. |
| `label` | A NIP-32 label (`l`). |
| `label_namespace` | A NIP-32 label namespace (`L`). |
| `group` | A group or channel id (NIP-29 `h`, a Marmot or Buzz channel). |
| `word` | A muted word. |
| `identity` | A NIP-39 external identity, `platform:identity`. |
| `sha256` | The SHA-256 of a blob (a reported media file, NIP-56 `x`). |
| `git_commit` | A git commit id: the earliest unique commit NIP-34 names a repository by. |
| `btih` | A BitTorrent info hash. |
| `key_package_ref` | A Marmot KeyPackageRef. |
| `schema_hash` | A ContextVM schema hash. |
| `schema_namespace` | A ContextVM schema namespace. |
| `app` | An application identifier (a software asset's `i`). |
| `wiki` | An unresolved wiki link: the target slug as written. |
| `list` | A list named but not declared (a parent list by name). |
| `object` | An opaque object id an audit entry names (a channel UUID, a media hash). |
